prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1215; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claimant reported a sideswipe collision while changing lanes on the highway. Vehicle damage appears limited to the right rear quarter panel and driver side mirror. Claimant states the other driver did not signal before merging. Injury reported as a shoulder strain, with the claimant saying pain began within an hour of the collision. Claimant is not represented by counsel. Photos requested.

Entry 2: Received photos of the claimant's vehicle from the scene. Damage consistent with the description given on the initial call. Claimant confirmed the other vehicle left the scene before police arrived. Police report number requested from the claimant. Claimant has not yet provided it.

Entry 3: Spoke with the claimant about medical treatment. Claimant visited an urgent care clinic and was advised to avoid heavy lifting and to follow up with a physician. Claimant has a follow-up appointment scheduled. Provided the claimant with a list of documents needed to evaluate the injury claim, including treatment records and wage information if lost time from work is claimed.

Entry 4: Claimant asked whether a lawyer is required to pursue the claim. Explained that representation is optional and that the claimant may choose to handle the claim directly. Claimant said they would continue without representation for now. Provided the claimant with the company's claim process overview and a timeline for the next steps.

Entry 5: Reviewed the file. Liability under review based on the claimant's account and the scene photos. Shoulder injury treatment is ongoing, so the bodily injury portion remains open. Scheduled a follow-up call with the claimant once the medical records arrive. Diary set for review in thirty days.
